title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the patient information leaflet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Package leaflet
options.lineage: the patient information leaflet folded inside every medicine box
options.thesis: Each check reads like the leaflet in a medicine box: numbered sections, plain words, the warning boxed first.
options.viewport: A spot-blue band with the name and New check, History, Sign out; a numbered contents list on the left; section 1 holds the confirmed claim, the verdict and the 0-100 scale; the not-medical-advice box sits right.
options.risk: Can read as a document rather than a tool if the forms and progress are set as prose.

raised.raise: A progress stage that changes holds its highlight until the reader reaches it.
One spot colour, used only for section numbers, the header band and rules, never as decoration.
Every number in one tabular face: scores, counts, years and PMIDs line up.
Evidence weight on a fixed ramp: passage markers sized from one scale, never ad hoc.
Rules run only horizontal and vertical: no rounded cards, no diagonals.

options.label: Evidence Facts panel
options.lineage: the Supplement Facts panel on the back of every bottle
options.thesis: The verdict printed as the regulated panel on the bottle the claim came from.
options.viewport: A tall Evidence Facts panel on the left with heavy rules (articles read, passages supporting, contradicting, score); the verbatim quotes run beside it.
options.risk: The nutrition-label parody is a familiar trope; played loosely it reads as a joke.

options.label: Warm consumer app
options.thesis: One idea per card, plain labels, one colour that only ever marks what you can press.
options.viewport: A single column of cards: confirmed claim, verdict card, quote cards; the action colour only on New check.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and reads as a working app; loses on audience identification, since evaluators see a template.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from a hundred consumer apps.

options.label: Boarding pass and gate board
options.thesis: Pipeline stages as a departure board.
options.viewport: Progress as a board of stages.
options.risk: Travel costume on a science tool.
options.case: Strong for progress only; evaluators don't read evidence as travel.
options.kept: A changed state holds its highlight until noticed.

options.label: Convention circle catalogue
options.thesis: Results as a packed numbered grid.
materials: single ink plus one spot colour
options.case: No link to evidence or medicine.
options.kept: One spot colour used only for structure.

options.label: Data field
options.thesis: Evidence as a strobing data field.
options.viewport: A field of bars behind the verdict.
options.case: Obscures the quotes the product exists to show.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Articles as stars sized by weight.
options.case: One article per check gives the chart nothing to plot.
options.kept: Hierarchy on one fixed size ramp.

options.label: Transit diagram
options.thesis: The pipeline as a rail line.
options.case: Movement is not the story; evidence is.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fact-check app: white cards, a coloured verdict badge, a blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, a verdict badge card, quote cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
